title: KeyChainConfigFile
description: Configuration file identified by its $schema URL.

type.description: Key chain type. For a `private-jwk` key source without `activeJwk`, `standalone` makes `jwk` the signing key and `crt` its chain, leaf first; `internalChain` makes `jwk` a CA key and the last `crt` entry its CA certificate (created if `crt` is omitted), and the import generates a new signing key with a certificate issued by it. Without `type`, `jwk` is a CA key only if `rotationPolicy.enabled` is true and `crt` is not a single self-signed certificate that is not a CA. For `regenerate`, it is the type of the new key chain and must equal `keySource.keyChainType` if both are set. For the other key sources, it must match the key chain they describe.
